name: MFDB Diagram - Directory Hierarchy
description: Architecture diagram of the 4-Tier Directory Organization Framework (Tier 1 Catalog -> Tier 2 Gallery -> Tier 3 Project or Purpose Folder -> Tier 4 Dependent Folder), Binary Path-vs-Project Mutual Exclusion (.path.bejson vs bejson_project.json), >=75% Confidence Anomaly Remediation (flags, action=MOVE, action_modifier), <Status>/<Type> Archive Routing, and Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks.

shapes.label: Depth 0: Admin Root
shapes.text:
/storage/emulated/0/Admin
Contains root .path.bejson manifest.
Anchors all Tier 1 Catalogs.

shapes.label: Tier 1: Catalog (Depth 1)
shapes.text:
Primary domain buckets: Core, Dev, Libraries, Processing, Resources, SD_Fallback, System.
Tracked via .path.bejson.

shapes.label: Tier 2: Gallery (Depth 2)
shapes.text:
Thematic sub-categories: Dev/Tools, Dev/Repos, Dev/Python, Resources/Images, System/Job_Management.
Tracked via .path.bejson.

shapes.label: Tier 3A: Purpose Folder
shapes.text:
Dedicated non-project organizational or asset folder (e.g. Images/icons, Python/Stable, Jobs).
Receives .path.bejson.

shapes.label: Tier 3B: Project / Tool Folder
shapes.text:
Immutable self-contained project, repo, library bundle, or CLI/web tool.
Moves as a unified block. Tracked via bejson_project.json.

shapes.label: Tier 4: Dependent Folders
shapes.text:
Standard internal subdirectories strictly inside a Tier 3 Project: lib, config, data, exports, backups, dev, docs, assets, logs, out.
Excluded from .path.bejson.

shapes.label: .path.bejson (Schema v101)
shapes.text:
BEJSON 104a Path Declaration:
1. id (UUIDv4)
2. purpose
3. current_path
4. alias_history
5. flags (>=75% confidence)
6. action (MOVE)
7. action_modifier (dest path)

shapes.label: >=75% Confidence Remediation
shapes.text:
Flags MISPLACED or JUNK folders only when confidence >= 75%.
Populates action='MOVE' and action_modifier='<destination>' for automated file/folder routing.

shapes.label: bejson_project.json Tracker
shapes.text:
Project Tracker & Project Chunker Registry:
Enforces solid integer Version, Project_GUID, Status (Active, Inactive, Archived, Legacy), and Type ($PROJECT_TYPE_LEDGER).

shapes.label: Projects_Archive/<Status>/<Type>
shapes.text: Routes archived projects by Status first (Active, Inactive, Legacy, Archived) then by canonical Type (python, bash, react, website, app, skill, library).

shapes.label: PreToolUse Hook Guardrail
shapes.text:
pre_tool_use_guardrail.py:
Blocks .path.bejson inside Project or Tier 4 Dependent folders.
Blocks bejson_project.json inside Path folders.

shapes.label: PostInvocation & Chunker Hooks
shapes.text:
post_invocation_auditor.py & project_chunker_hook.py:
Audits modified trackers, enforces mutual exclusion, and syncs Status/Type on --track --chunk.
